bug_semantics: Stored XSS in the conversion-table search highlighter. ConvertTable/ConversionTable parses MISP/STIX conversion input_text and output_text into cell strings, then when a search is active renders those cells with Vue v-html="highlight(String(row[col.key]))". highlight() regex-escaped only the query and wrapped matches in <mark class="ctbl-mark"> without HTML-escaping the cell, so markup stored in conversion data (for example a MISP Attribute.value or STIX name/pattern) was interpreted as HTML. The empty-query branch of highlight() returned the raw string, but the template already used escaped [[ ]] interpolation when search was empty; the exploitable sink is the search-active v-html path. CVE-2026-73161 remains PUBLISHED (CIRCL CNA; GHSA withdrawn_at null). Vendor v1.5 notes list this as CWE-79 affecting 1.4; the CNA range 0..1.4.0 is broader than git history because the table view did not exist at v1.3.
flaw_origin: First written in 3b521470283e5af0e13a9f6b10c134f530e6210f ('add: [convert] implemente table view' by ecrou-exact), which added website/web/static/js/graph/convertTable.js with the unescaped highlight() helper and the v-html cell sink. The parent already had a different, already-escaped search highlighter in convert/history.html (escapeHtml then <mark class="search-hl">); the table view did not reuse that helper. 772374333db626456cfb65bdd0b9b857c006ad90 only renamed convertTable.js to conversionTable.js (97% similarity). The vulnerable highlight body and v-html call are byte-stable from introduction through the parent of the fix.

reasoning: CVE-2026-73161/GHSA-9p42-c923-p9c9 is a real published stored-XSS advisory, not withdrawn or rejected. The conversion-table Vue component feeds attacker-controlled conversion-cell strings through highlight() into a v-html sink without HTML-escaping, so a stored payload such as executes when a viewer searches the table. The smallest public first-write of those lines is 3b521470283e5af0e13a9f6b10c134f530e6210f, which added convertTable.js; the immediate parent tree lacks that file and the ctbl-mark/v-html highlight pairing, so this is not a move, revert, or rename. 7723743 is a later Convert-to-Conversion rename and is not the BIC. No finer member commits are reconstructable: the object is single-parent, not a merge/squash aggregate, and GitHub has no PR to decompose. The unescaped highlight body survived unchanged until ac495641ef3ca927676a73ba8f1bcdfd952413df, which is the advisory-linked fix (and the direct functional fix); the following test commit only pins the helper. Version cross-check: the table view is absent at v1.3, present and still vulnerable at v1.4, and the fix is contained in v1.5, matching the vendor 1.4-affected / 1.5-patched boundary.
